    Global Euler counts from concrete translation slices #

    The concrete level fibers partition all surviving indecomposables. Since official arrow multiplicities are supported only on adjacent levels, the sum of the adjacent slice counts is the global arrow count. These two facts identify the mesh-matrix total with the graded Euler expression used by the intrinsic factor-excess theorem.
